mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.chain_id, n.name, n.parent_id, n.sort_order, n.is_deleted, n.deleted_at, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM chain_node n WHERE n.chain_id = #{chainId} AND n.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY n.sort_order ASC, n.id ASC
SELECT id, chain_id, name, parent_id, sort_order, is_deleted, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM chain_node WHERE chain_id = #{chainId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT e.id AS enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, e.unified_code AS unified_code, e.legal_representative AS legal_representative, e.registered_address AS registered_address, e.region_id AS region_id, e.is_local AS is_local, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patent_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.maintenance_years >= 5 THEN p.id END) AS high_value_count FROM enterprise e INNER JOIN enterprise_node en ON e.id = en.enterprise_id INNER JOIN patent_node pn ON en.node_id = pn.node_id INNER JOIN patent p ON pn.patent_id = p.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE en.node_id = #{nodeId} AND e.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.unified_code, e.legal_representative, e.registered_address, e.region_id, e.is_local ORDER BY patent_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
